column3: I know he attends every lecture, but I've never seen him fight.
I think he went to train at the volcano?
Victoria's been gone for a while.
What's with her?
...Unless it's something to do with him. Hm~
Kiki gave her life to save all of us?
...Let's make good use of our time and work hard.
Have you met Cal?
He's kinda weird, but kinda cool.
And by that I mean, kinda hot.
Oh, don't tell Victoria I said that!
It feels really lonely here now...
This is the main lecture hall, but we do a lot of classes outside, too. By the water, or on Pyrous Mountain, or in the Training Grounds.
It's like there's a field trip every day!
Is Kiki really gone?
I mean, she can't be, right?
She'll come back with some super-zen-ish power, somehow!
Like, "One must transcend life in order to transcend death!"
That sounds like something she'd say, right?!
I mainly come here to hike, but I'd never miss a chance to listen to Kiki's lectures.
She's like a sage, that girl.
I didn't know her that well, but even I'm going to miss her.
This is Kiki's room. But she's out at the moment.
Oh, you're looking for her?
Hm, well, she went down to teach a class in the Training Grounds.
You could probably try and catch her after the lecture.
They're basically right out the front door; can't miss them.
Kiki went down to teach a class in the Training Grounds.
VICTORIA: Azurine Island is just a skip east of here.
You took a boat here, right?
You should be able to reach it easily.
Whatever Team Meteor is up to, we've gotta stop them.
I'll keep everything steady here while you're out.
Kiki is currently resting and has asked not to be disturbed.
Victoria just ran out of here though; didn't you see her?
Kiki is currently amidst a lecture.
I cannot allow you to enter this way.
Please enter through the front to attend her lecture.
VICTORIA: Deep breaths...
\PN, I apologize to you on behalf of the academy.
You've been wronged.
I've never seen her fall apart so fast.
All of this is... a lot of firsts.
???: Victoria!
There's news.
VICTORIA: I'm kind of over news right now.
LETTIE: A couple of the students were hiking out at Azurine Island--
Apparently there's some suspicious folk over there?
Like full black suit and heavy machinery type suspicious?
VICTORIA: That'll be it.
Thanks, Lettie.
If anything else comes up, bring it to me.
Kiki is going to be resting for a while.
LETTIE: You got it, girlfriend!
VICTORIA: I have to stay here.
This school needs at least one person who can be honest and keep things moving.
And, although I'm furious at her right now,
So does Kiki.
Can you check on Azurine Island?
If anything else happens, or if that Machine turns up, I'll let you know as soon as I can.
No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
AME: \PN?
Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
Anyway...
AME: Oh, you're coming in from Apophyll Academy?
...It's true that that used to be a Gym, but not anymore.
Kiki was forced to retire due to some ongoing health concerns.
Are you sure the stress of battling won't be too much on her?
...Well, I suppose I can give you her old notes, just in case.
Thanks to her school's focus on meditation, the mental energy around there is out of this world!
When she uses Meditate, her Pokémon will be much, much stronger than normal, so don't give her that chance!
By the way, for beating the Fighting-type, although many people go for Flying-types, that could be a risky play.
With all the sand and ash down there, it's easy for it to get kicked up and vision to be lost. But Kiki's mentally focused Pokémon will often still land attacks!
Rather than Flying-types, try using the mental energy against her! Psychic-types can really do a number down there!
Good luck, whatever happens.
I've been looking forward to coming here for so long, and yet...
Many of the older students here say it's not what it used to be-- but it's still everything I'd imagined.
CAL: \PN.
CAL: I'm glad you're here.
The truth is, I was the one who passed the report of this going on to the Nightclub.
I probably could've done a lot to stop this, but...
...Well, how is she?
This was another Anomaly's doing, of course.
You just defeated it, and our star actor ran through here.
It's currently hiding in Kiki's room.
A Pokémon that can steal the feelings of others...
You can probably guess what it is, right?
With how much pressure she was putting on herself, when I found that thing...
It was willing to help, and I thought it might just do the job.
Show her that she's enough herself.
She doesn't have to keep trying to be someone else.
...It could've been a little nicer about it.
Sorry about that.
I'll go patch things up with Victoria. Make sure she's on the right path.
The Pokémon is all yours though.
Best clean it up before she tries to punch it or something...
Sorry for springing this on you but your help is, as always, irreplaceable.
VICTORIA: Oh, you're done already?
I was just... coming to check.
I can't say I'm really happy about Cal setting this whole thing up...
But it's over now.
The students have dispersed, and no one seems to really remember what happened...
...Which is just fine by me.
If you happened to forget it too, I can't say I'd mind.
But... he was right.
Maybe I did need to acknowledge that part of myself still.
Maybe it was... a little bit helpful.
Even if he's stupid and I hate him.
I don't hate him.
But I am mad at him, so don't tell him that!
If I'm acknowledging my feelings, he can acknowledge that he really needs to stop going behind people's backs, even if it IS for the greater good or whatever!
...Anyway, thanks for your help.
I'm going to... take some time and keep processing this.
I don't need to do it like Kiki.
I just need to do it like me.
That would be enough.
'Ey kid! You want me to teach your Pokémon some special moves? Take a look what I got!
What suits your fancy?
Gastro Acid is gonna run you a single Blue Shard.
Come back when you've got it.
Perfect.
Recycle is gonna run you two Purple Shards.
Endeavor is gonna run you three Green Shards.
Pain Split is gonna run you three Red Shards.
Any time, kid.
Did you know?
The best place to train your Defense is by striking the Magcargo that bar Pyrous Mountain's lava flow!
Haaaaaah!
Yes
No
Gastro Acid
Recycle
Endeavor
Pain Split
KIKI: ...
VICTORIA: There you go-- just focus on breathing.
Like in Beginning Meditation, right?
Keep it steady. You're okay.
KIKI: "Okay" is a rather generous assessment of either my condition or the circumstances.
There's no longer any point to saving face.
After a display like that-- collapsing in the courtyard...
Who wouldn't be shaken?
VICTORIA: You're being too hard on yourself!
Nobody could be as strong as you've been through all of this.
Look at everything you've done, all the people you've made happy, and--
KIKI: And for as strong as I've been, I'm still too weak.
VICTORIA: Please calm down.
KIKI: How can I?
Defeat the inner chaos?
Did you think I was only talking about zen of the mind?
I could be centered to dead-zero and I will still end up just that.
No amount of meditation is going to change the simple fact that my body is killing itself!
VICTORIA: That's enough!
You know what hurts even more than seeing this happen to you?!
Watching you do it to yourself!
Sometimes people get sick-- big fucking deal!
Even then, they get through it with the people near and dear to them.
What they DON'T do is lie to everyone around them and go on pretending that everything is fine and dandy when it's clearly anything but!
You've put all this pressure on yourself to try and maintain perfect appearances and outward peace,
But really you're tearing yourself up inside as much as anyone!?
Don't you see the irony you've committed yourself to being a victim of?
KIKI: Of course, you're correct.
I am keenly aware of the folly of it all.
And despite my lectures, my practice, and my teaching, I've been unable to stop it.
That, too, has been a great source of shame to me.
How can I advocate for mental and spiritual health when I can't even maintain it for myself?
I have felt I was a sham for so long that lying about this was only natural.
VICTORIA: Then come clean.
Be honest about it, and we can all start figuring out how to get through it together.
Then there is one more matter I must be transparent about.
VICTORIA: ...What?
KIKI: \PN.
I cannot give you Strength.
VICTORIA: What.
KIKI: The Machine went missing from my care not too long ago.
I believe it was stolen.
VICTORIA: Then, all of these hoops about graduation...
KIKI: The urgency has not escaped me.
I hoped I would be able to recover it before you completed these tasks.
But, as you can imagine--
VICTORIA: I can't believe you.
KIKI: Victoria!
KIKI: Please leave me.
I wish to be alone right now.
KIKI: I'm sorry.
VICTORIA: So, that's it.
Apophyll is safe,
And empty.
CAIN: Hey, we did everything we could...
VICTORIA: Like that's some kind of justification or reassurance?
We did everything we could-- and it still wasn't enough!
Luckily we can take comfort in knowing it wasn't our negligence that ended her life, just our incompetence.
But maybe it was the first thing too.
I was the one who brought Cal here--
I should've known he was one of them!
CAIN: How could you have known?
VICTORIA: Oh, I don't know, maybe a hair-trigger temper might have been something of a red flag.
I was stupid.
CAIN: Hey, blaming yourself isn't going to help.
VICTORIA: ...
Sure.
Better to blame the real culprits.
Team Meteor.
Better to do what we can to make sure this doesn't happen to anyone else.
There was another PULSE-- somewhere in Byxbysion Wasteland.
And that's where your family is.
Do I have that right?
CAIN: Um, yeah, but...
My family and I aren't really...
VICTORIA: What?
So you're not on great terms, and you're just going to let them become the next victims?
CAIN: I didn't say that...
VICTORIA: You didn't have to.
You have a chance to save them, and you're hesitating.
Maybe this is why you have to tell yourself things like "You did everything you could."
CAIN: Okay, I'm... just gonna go.
VICTORIA: Wait, I'm sorry, I didn't mean--
VICTORIA: I'm sorry, that was uncalled for.
I... have a lot of work to do.
On myself, and...
Well, someone needs to lead the academy now.
Kiki chose me.
She expected that she was on her way out, but...
Not like this.
VICTORIA: Well, you can go on without me.
VICTORIA: I'm grateful that I had the chance to fight alongside you.
But this is where our adventure ends.
At least, my part of it.
VICTORIA: It looks like this is where my adventure ends.
Someone is going to have to tell the other students.
And I have no intention of keeping secrets.
And then class schedules, lectures, maintenance, paperwork, intake...
VICTORIA: There's so much to do...
VICTORIA: You'll keep fighting Team Meteor, won't you?
Byxbysion Wasteland...
The entrance is from a large door in South Obsidia.
You know it?
Someone has to go there and make sure they can't hurt anyone else.
Cain evidently won't do it, so...
It falls to you.
We're all behind you, \PN.
Make sure they pay for what they did.
VICTORIA: You were always the stronger one between us anyway.
Oh, the Machine Strength--
...I have a theory where it might have gone.
If it turns up, I'll be sure to get in touch with you.
The kids, the wasteland, and the city...
We'll save everyone.
We have to.
KIKI: Thank you for speaking with me.
It sounds like there is much to be done, but first,
As a new student, I'd like you to meet my apprentice.
I'd like you to meet my apprentice.
Victoria?
KIKI: We have a new student.
Would you please walk them through enrollment and introduce them to the basic facilities as I previously showed you?
KIKI: We have a visitor with some very important news.
I believe it will be prudent for you to hear them out as well.
VICTORIA: Um,
Haha?
Hi, \PN!
KIKI: ...Oh?
VICTORIA: Sensei, \PN and I already met in Reborn City!
She's the one I told you about who rescued me!
They're the one I told you about who rescued me!
He's the one I told you about who rescued me!
KIKI: I see...
I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents she brings might be baseless.
I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents they bring might be baseless.
I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents he brings might be baseless.
But in that case, I suppose it is fortunate that we need not waste time doubting their credibility.
VICTORIA: ...Wait, is something wrong?
KIKI: Children have been kidnapped, it seems,
And in the same breath, something threatens to run afoul of our Academy.
I have built our home here up from sand and ashes in equal part.
I will not let it return to them.
You may rest assured that I will defend this place to my final breath.
VICTORIA: So, it's another PULSE...?
But we don't know what kind.
KIKI: We will issue a bulletin to all of the students.
Any suspicious machinery or activity anywhere on the beach should be reported to us at once.
VICTORIA: I'll have Lettie send out the word; it'll spread like wildfire.
KIKI: Then we need only wait for news to come in.
That leaves the matter of the children.
VICTORIA: By children, that wouldn't happen to be...
...Shelly, too?
VICTORIA: How did this happen...?
Well, what's important is saving them!
If it's just a bit of debris in the way, then we can definitely help!
Sensei, you'll let \PN take the Machine Strength, right?
It's true that Strength is typically bestowed on the graduates of our Academy,
Yet, to give it freely without meeting the same measures of achievement...
It is intrinsically disrespectful to those who have properly completed the program.
One must attain inner strength before acquiring worldly power.
VICTORIA: But Sensei, this is an emergency! Surely you can--
KIKI: Victoria.
Please,
Even in the most pressing of circumstances, we must remain calm and in control.
Indeed, these cases are when it is most necessary to do so.
Strife gives way to panic.
Panic, to chaos.
Yet it is order that will save the day.
VICTORIA: ...Yes, Sensei.
KIKI: ...And in any case, I was going to continue,
That disrespect must be weighed carefully against the immediacy of our circumstances.
Discretion is the better part of law.
Allow me to bend our customs to our current needs.
If you can prove that your power is equal to that of our top representatives, no one will be in a position to protest the requisition of Strength.
I believe this is the fairest way to expedite the usual process.
VICTORIA: Understood.
In other words, \PN just has to defeat me in battle, correct?
Correct, although...
Our other newest student would suffice as well.
Our newest student would suffice as well.
You are both exceptionally skilled.
VICTORIA: Oh, \PN has actually defeated Cal before!
KIKI: Is that so?
...But he has taken to our program like fish to water.
I believe it would be quite beneficial for him to have a rematch now that he has regained some control over himself.
VICTORIA: Admittedly, I am curious how he would do now...
KIKI: ...Hm?
You already went and faced him again?
VICTORIA: Wait, really?
KIKI: I see you are ahead of the curve.
...Very well, there need be no further dallying then.
Give Victoria and I just a moment to stay abreast of the situation for our respective parts, and then we will proceed.
KIKI: But he is on a retreat atop Pyrous Mountain,
And time is of the essence.
I believe it is most prudent to let \PN decide.
You may face my apprentice, Victoria, or our newest ace, Cal.
After you defeat one of them, you may apply for expedient graduation.
The choice is yours.
VICTORIA: I'll let Lettie know what's going on right away.
If you decide to fight me, I'll be waiting in the courtyard!
KIKI: You may face my apprentice, Victoria, or our newest ace, Cal.
You will find Victoria in the courtyard, and Cal atop Pyrous Mountain to the southwest.
One additional forewarning:
The Machine Strength cannot be used without its requisite badge.
In the early days of our academy, I was once its Leader too.
But recent events have forced me to evaluate my priorities, and I stepped away from the role.
Regardless, be aware of the upcoming obstacles.
KIKI: Thank you for waiting.
The students have been notified, and in a community this small, word will move quickly.
KIKI: I understand you've beaten Victoria, then.
...And Cal as well?
VICTORIA: Wait, what?
KIKI: Impressive, especially on such limited time.
KIKI: I presume you've beaten Cal, then.
That leaves only one matter to resolve.
